title: I Saw on Earth Another Light
description: I Saw on Earth Another Light in Tonic Solfa to ST. PETER, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Jones Very wrote these words. They were printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 91, “The Light from Within”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. PETER; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: I saw on earth an-oth-er light Than that which lit my eye Come forth, as from my soul with-in, And from a high-er sky.

lines: I saw on earth another light
Than that which lit my eye
Come forth, as from my soul within,
Its beams still shone unclouded on,
The sun I once had known had sunk
And on I walked, though dark the night,
Nor rose his orb by day;
As one to whom a surer guide
And lit, as by a lamp from heaven,
The world's dark track of sin.

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: Jones Very died in 1880.
credits: Words by Jones Very (1813–1880), public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to ST. PETER by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
